faq.answer: Most businesses cut automation platform spend by 80–90%. A company paying Zapier $400+/month for 50,000 tasks typically runs the same volume on a self-hosted n8n instance for $10–$50/month in server costs. Our free audit gives you the exact number for your account before you commit.
faq.question: How much can we save by migrating from Zapier to n8n?

faq.answer: No. We rebuild every Zap in n8n and run both systems in parallel, comparing outputs, until the n8n workflows are proven. Only then do we switch off Zapier. Your team and customers notice nothing except the smaller bill.
faq.question: Will our automations stop working during the migration?

faq.answer: A typical migration of 10–30 Zaps takes 2–4 weeks including the audit, rebuild, parallel testing, and cutover. Larger accounts with 50+ Zaps or custom API steps take longer — the audit gives you a firm timeline upfront.
faq.question: How long does a Zapier to n8n migration take?

faq.answer: n8n covers the major SaaS tools natively, and anything with an API can be connected through its HTTP node or a custom node we write in JavaScript. During the audit we flag any integration that needs special handling — there are very few.
faq.question: Does n8n support all the apps our Zaps use?

faq.answer: n8n itself is free and open-source. Self-hosted, your only cost is a small VPS ($10–$50/month for most workloads). Managed n8n Cloud plans exist too and are still far cheaper than Zapier at volume. Either way, per-task pricing is gone.
faq.question: What does n8n cost to run after migration?

faq.answer: Yes — most migration clients move to a monthly maintenance plan. We monitor your workflows, handle API changes from your connected apps, and keep adding automations as new needs come up. See our workflow automation services for the full picture.
